thisRun.horse: Wine Dark Sea / Enfjaar / Starford / Point Of Law / Omni Man / Kizlyar / Small Fry

evidence.facts: Seven European-trained original Cup nominees arrived in Melbourne and are based at Werribee post-arrival quarantine. Report confirms current spring targets and recent stakes evidence: Wine Dark Sea G3 Geoffrey Freer winner; Enfjaar G3 Glorious Stakes winner and Caulfield Cup exemption; Starford G3 Alleged Stakes winner; Omni Man fourth G3 Ballyroan with Caulfield/Geelong Cup path; Point Of Law G3 Bahrain Trophy winner and future Ciaron Maher transfer; Kizlyar Ascot Stakes winner; Small Fry York Stayers Handicap winner with Geelong Cup path. Campaign/status evidence only; no numeric rating inferred.

Official RV handicapping report: Zahrann received 0.5kg Caulfield and Melbourne Cup penalty after Naturalism Stakes win; Saint George passed Caulfield Cup first elimination but remained yet to pass Melbourne Cup first elimination at publication; Aethelwulf passed Melbourne Cup first elimination after Newcastle Gold Cup win and received no weight penalty. No rating inferred.
